isolated_config: XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME under scratch/e35; real HOME kept for the toolchain

install.repo_writes: none; the lockfile and cache are in the user data dir

untrusted_workspace.error: project-local plugin source is blocked because the workspace is untrusted

hook_test.command: muse plugins hook test e35-probe:mark --fixture fixture.json --json

doctor.after_approve: same row; the doctor reports the origin, not the approval state

session_start.method: MSP session/start over `muse serve --trust-workspace`, no turn
session_start.result: session created idle; the SessionStart marker did not fire
session_start.reading: not evidence of a security hole: the hook was inert before approve and the direct hook test fires it. It is an instrument gap: this MSP start path did not dispatch plugin SessionStart hooks, so 'fires in a session' is unmeasured here. A turn was not spent to force it.

finding: A project-scoped install is still a user-store install, gated by workspace trust, and its hook is not effective until the person approves it. A checkout can supply the plugin source, but cannot make Muse run the hook without `muse plugins approve`, which is per capability definition hash.
